title: Research: Historical SELL / BUY −5% Backtest v1
body:
## Completed research — no deployment
Final published SHA:5d5092b5d03e16f03241c1b5a5d5a19c1816c9c7.
Branch from unchanged main a14ebf9c268bea5cb01de962edfb98b8df94652a. Protocol c872a0a2aa3fde0e0c6c3f14983f63b7a1589429 and Draft PR published before calculations. PR9/PR10 used as immutable read-only snapshots.

**The frozen SELL / BUY−5% policy does not outperform Buy & Hold over the full2021–2November2026 sample.** It reduces drawdown but misses substantial long-term appreciation. This is a conclusion about the economic policy, not proof that the sector flag has no predictive information.

## Mandatory control gate passed before long economics
- Exact original sector rule: AMD/NVDA/MU/TSM/AVGO/AMAT/LRCX five-trading-session returns; >=4negative AND equal-weight mean<QQQreturn5; false/not-true→true transitions, previous warmup state retained.
- No SOX/VIX/other factor added to sales.
- PR10 control:4dates,44daily sector states,15generated output files byte-identical.
-66historical-adapter default engine cases equal to archived PR10.
-New full-history provider snapshot matches control dates and2730overlap OHLC bars.

## Data and accounting
2020warmup;1465study sessions,134sector activations, all11requested stocks plus requested context indices/ETFs/VIX. Frozen raw Yahoo OHLCV/actions, URLs, retrievalUTC, firstTradeDate, eligibility and hashes included.
NBIS starts only at verified post-resumption regular session2024-10-21; earlier suspended YNDX not fabricated/spliced. PLTR trades from2020-09-30 and is eligible at2021start.
Regular-session requests, XNYS calendar/DST, no invested missing-session fill.
Consistent split-normalized share ledger plus contemporaneous nominal prices/quantities;35split-window causal-return checks and split-unit NAV invariance. No dividend-adjusted-close mixing. Gross ex-date dividend receivable, no invented pay dates/reinvestment/interest.

Two prespecified100000USD portfolios:
1. RESERVED11:11equal initial capital slots; unavailable NBIS slot stays cash until eligibility.
2. COMPARABLE10:10initially traded names, fully allocated, no later entrants.
No rebalance or annual reset. Both fixed-current-survivor universes remain selection-biased, not historically neutral panels.

Reserved11size5% also slightly outperforms in2026YTD33.99% vs32.78%; still far behind overall. Annual-performance.csv includes all strategies, annual MaxDD and cash fractions, seeded by prior year NAV without resetting account state.

## Why it loses long term
Repeated sales can eventually exhaust free shares; no unstated50%core floor or order expiry was added.
Old low-price sales may never reach their GTC buy limits again; the policy parks money outside later appreciation.
Comparable10 average cash/NAV:51.46% forsize5%,73.61% forsize10%.
5%-size realized closed savings50893.22USD are outweighed by open missing-share marked benefit−394153.78USD and missed dividends4810.90USD.
10%-size corresponding29294.50,−521071.62,5752.02USD.
Ledger delta identity validated; gross proceeds are not profit.
Buybacks improve final capital vs sale-only by169590.12/24730.84USD but still do not catch B&H.
Across11stocks5%-size1174sales/993closed/181open;10%-size675sales/569closed/106open. Completed-only gains do not establish effectiveness.

Signal quality includes BOTH actual-position-selected sales and separately labelled hypothetical one-unit sales for every eligible stock to avoid depletion selection bias.1374mature hypothetical executions:681(49.56%)no5%low-hit within10following full sessions;749(54.51%)positive terminal10 return.134common correlated dates are not independent1374trials. No final-day execution price fabricated.

## Stability and old policy
64prespecified fixed-buyback combinations across sizes/3/5/7/10%target, delay1/2, base/strict fills and5/10bp costs:0outperform matching-cost B&H in either universe. No best configuration selected.
Regimes fixed by prior known QQQclose/MA200/R20 and affect analysis only. Conditional disconnected returns not sold as a separate strategy.
PR9 optional E uses exactly archived JS except study-start constant2026→2021; source-only change tested. It is the old tactical restoration policy, not a fabricated full fundamental DecisionEngine replay.

## Deliverables and verification
All requested files under reports/historical-sell-buyback-v1/:Russian executive summary, historical signals, annual/portfolio/stock performance, sales/buys/open lots/signal quality/sensitivity/validation, raw inputs/manifests and offline code.
**54tests passed,0failures,1environment deprecation warning**:2main,30inherited PR10 execution,22historical/data/accounting checks.
Published GitHub blob/tree hashes matched the local content-addressed tree;8critical source files actually read back via API. Fresh independent materialization of this exact published tree reran control→prepare→run→prior→quality→report and reproduced107files byte-identically;54tests passed again. verification.json states the precise method (not a claimed CLI clone while shell network was blocked).

## Limits / stop
Original publication/vintages not independently attested; next-midnight availability and daily OHLC/limit queue assumptions remain explicit. Gross dividend pay dates/tax/ADRfees unavailable. Fixed survivor universe biased; repeatedly studied2021–2026 is not untouched holdout. Production decisions/positions/orders remain UNKNOWN. No production-ready claim.
No engine changes outside new research files, no production calls/orders, no merge/deploy/force push or threshold fitting. Stop after this Draft PR.
